methodology: Keyboard activation of real production UI controls. Event completion requires two requestAnimationFrame callbacks after the latest root DOM mutation; generation guards cancel earlier callbacks. Conversion additionally waits for committed graph card. AppCore/Viz render-function durations and named production operations recorded independently. Instrumented development/StrictMode; paint opportunity proxy, not compositor completion. Three matched reload sessions per fixture; baseline/candidate ordering AB, BA, AB. No background test/build load during final measurement.
